feature: Rule 0 PR 3: the read-only table page at /friends/table/[id] (plan 2026-10-16-rule-zero.md, PR 3; the read boards T1 to T10, the needsAnalysis seat and the expired page L4/H3)
note: Needs RULE_ZERO_ENABLED=true and its parent SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED=true for the reader (registry: RULE_ZERO_ENABLED needs SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED), and the fixture from scripts/seed-rule-zero-fixture.mts run with RZ_FIXTURE_USER set to the account the sheet signs in as (E2E_AUDIT_USER_EMAIL, the audit account user_3Hdjdoc...) on a SCRATCH BRANCH off local-dev only: the seed refuses production, staging and local-dev (assertScratchBranch) and must equal RZ_FIXTURE_BRANCH. It seeds Colin's pod Thursday night (you, Colin the owner, Peter, and Max, Colin's friend and not yours) with fixed table ids, every reading a real analysis of a cloned list. The open tables close 20 hours after the seed runs, so reseed before a rerun the next day. From PR 4 the page records each draw (markTableSeen) and its 20-second poll reads unread seats on the spot, so a run moves S5's seen_at and T9's reading: reseed before every run.
